subject: POC Sprint: kickoff scheduling, preflight checklist, and network gate check
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@edgescale.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: POC Sprint — kickoff window and preflight checklist

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a 2-week POC with Redwood. To make the hands-on working session productive, would you confirm availability for a 90-minute kickoff where we can:

- Review sample prompts and success criteria
- Walk through routing and model variants
- Run a small routing/load validation (up to 200 concurrent threads)
- Validate sandbox API keys and VPC allowlist

Suggested slots (US/Eastern):
- Wed Dec 3, 10:00–11:30
- Thu Dec 4, 14:00–15:30

Preflight items (we'll send a checklist but appreciate early answers):
- Sandbox API keys or a placeholder for token rotation
- VPC allowlist CIDRs for our staging IPs (we'll provide)
- Test data subset (JSON lines)
- Point of contact for network/firewall

Attaching a quick runbook and a template for the allowlist/credentials.

Thanks — if either slot works let us know and we'll send the invite.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-poc-runbook.pdf (10KB stub), staging-credentials-template.txt (1KB stub)
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@edgescale.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@edgescale.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC Sprint — kickoff window and preflight checklist

Hi Vivek / team,

Thanks — Thu Dec 4 14:00 ET would work better for us. Quick q: for the load validation you mentioned "200 concurrent threads" — can you clarify how we simulate that from our side and whether you need any elevated sandbox credentials? Our network lead (Raj) will need the allowlist details to submit a ticket.

We'll attach a sample dataset by end of day.

-Maria
VP, Platform Engineering
EdgeScale Inc.
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@edgescale.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -0500
Subject: Confirming Thu Dec 4 14:00 ET — agenda and pre-reqs

Hi Maria — great, locking Thu Dec 4, 14:00–15:30 ET. Calendar invite will follow; invite will include a dial-in and temporary staging link.

Agenda:
1) 15 min — introductions & success criteria
2) 20 min — prompt review & routing design
3) 30 min — staging walk-through (keys, endpoints, KV cache)
4) 20 min — short load validation (we'll run a 10-min ramp to ~200 concurrent simulated sessions)
5) 5 min — next steps / rollouts

Pre-req checklist (please copy into your ticket):
- Provide sandbox API key OR add placeholder to staging-credentials-template.txt
- Add these CIDRs to allowlist: 54.172.12.0/24, 18.204.9.0/24
- Share a 200–500 line test dataset (JSONL)
- Assign a network contact for the session (name + email)

Attachments: network-allowlist.csv

If Raj can confirm the allowlist by EOD Wednesday we should be clear.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@edgescale.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@edgescale.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Confirming Thu Dec 4 14:00 ET — agenda and pre-reqs

Hey all,

Quick update — our exec sync overlapped unexpectedly. Can we push the kickoff by 1 hour to 15:00–16:30 ET on Thu Dec 4? If that doesn't work we can move to Fri Dec 5 at 11:00 ET. Raj confirms he'll join but needs the CIDRs to open the firewall rule.

Apologies for the short notice.

Thanks,
Maria
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@edgescale.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@edgescale.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Confirming Thu Dec 4 14:00 ET — agenda and pre-reqs

> Hey all,
>
> Quick update — our exec sync overlapped unexpectedly. Can we push the kickoff by 1 hour to 15:00–16:30 ET on Thu Dec 4? If that doesn't work we can move to Fri Dec 5 at 11:00 ET. Raj confirms he'll join but needs the CIDRs to open the firewall rule.

Hi Maria — Fri Dec 5 11:00 ET works for us. I've updated the invite (new time: Fri Dec 5, 11:00 ET / 16:00Z) and attached the final runbook and network checklist.

Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/987654321
Prep links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-poc-sprint
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521

Quick notes:
- For the load validation we'll run a gradual ramp from 10 -> 200 simulated sessions using our client — no elevated credentials required; we'll coordinate the origin IPs in the meet.
- Please add the CIDRs Lauren listed so Raj can confirm from his side.
- If you prefer we can do the load test in a separate 30-min window after the walkthrough; team has bandwidth.

See you Friday — invite includes dial-in and staging token (placeholder).

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
